county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.

Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide or get specialized rehabilitative services as required for a resident.

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to voice grievances without discrimination or reprisal and the facility must establish a grievance policy and make prompt efforts to resolve grievances.
Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide activities to meet all resident's needs.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
